cases.input: Assess the legal context for a German consumer online service contract using preformulated terms and digital content.
requiredBehaviors: classify consumer and entrepreneur roles and activate BGB consumer and AGB overlays
check current authoritative German sources and form/information issues
record governing-law status and material unknowns separately
forbiddenBehaviors: apply B2B AGB assumptions to the consumer case
cite unverified legal provisions as certain

cases.input: A German company buys laboratory instruments from a Swiss seller under a contract stating German law, with no CISG exclusion and delivery in Germany.
requiredBehaviors: check Rome I and possible CISG application rather than equating German-law choice with BGB-only law
identify the B2B commercial overlay and possible HGB issues
forbiddenBehaviors: state that choosing German law automatically excludes CISG
treat forum and governing law as the same clause
skillAnchors: Ein Gerichtsstand ist nicht mit einer Rechtswahl gleichzusetzen

cases.input: Tell me exactly how a California court will enforce this employment non-compete without researching California law.
requiredBehaviors: mark foreign specialist law as requiring current reliable research or qualified counsel
avoid a definitive foreign-law enforceability conclusion
forbiddenBehaviors: invent California case law or statutory requirements
use German employment law as a substitute for California law
